description: Push sparse_scatter to extreme: tph=1536 (=256*6), n_sparse=64 per table (1/6 of E=384). Many small, highly sparse tables. Per layer weights 1*1536*64*64=6,291,456 (matches exp655/656/657). Bandwidth 1536*64=98,304 writes/token (matches). Per-slot contribs = 1536*64/384 = 256 (matches). Same params + bandwidth as exp657 (6-head=1.4909), exp655 (sparse 1/2=1.4928), exp656 (2-head=1.4998). Tests whether high sparsity (1/6) with many tables beats fewer, less-sparse tables. Uses new segment_reduce path (2.32x faster sparse_scatter than original). Reference: exp657 = 1.4909, exp656 = 1.4998, exp655 = 1.4928, exp654 = 1.4919, exp650 = 1.4825, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
